book.title: 1 TESALONAIKA Poloyo Tesalonaika Yeneke Namolo Takoa Wia Wetekane Pipia

content: Akolaline Wene Epetekakete Toatekole

Anu oya-lawe kipala eya wa wipitikete oko-ye. Akolaline wene epetekakete toatekoile totome i i wa kiwi mane mane okoona. Eina mane mane okoona toa kime litia tekete tiki. Opi Ali Muno Yesuno ibini wedekaketepa eya tamene wa kiwi kowitoa oko-ye. Widikoa meki toa wedoa toomoa pamene.
Ile tamene ile tamene wa Ali Muno Yesuno agale patu kautakoa kakete okoonakale kime wene tekete tiki.
Akolaliyopa kiwi wene ki̱yo akeneya mea epetekoa toma pomotono wene pia mekono, mone koua piamatiki atoa-kiti-pala koua piameamene.
Nitameneya kini atoa-pala koua mekilepa Akolaline lenekeka ete ali atoane lenekeka wene ki̱yo akeneya mea tamene.
Nipa Akolali wene toameneya meki ali-kitame atoa-kiti po̱i motekete toa potokakete tiki toa toameamene.
Neke oyago yotokoa one natono-pala koua pikile pade toameamene. Enile poanele tiki ali-kitipa Akolaliyo kibu moo. Kipala papete pubu okoona toa nitoono, toameamene. Ni edoa-mo.
Akolaliyo totopa one wa kayo oa takoa motikilepa eni poanele tomotoa tokoya mena. Onekele epetanele-kama takamotoa ni toka.

Panagome-kiti kipala i ukule wawa toamokomepa nipa aline agalepa kote tokolo wakoya mena. Akolaline agalepa kote tokolo wakoya. Nipa one Epetane Yomini kiwike awia mepoano pa wa moa wetekakago Akolaline agale eni wakoya.
Keraisuno ali atoake wene mekoa mekete toatikile i i wane wiane mekatekule toamoko. Kini kini wene mekanali yoma poatekoile Akolaliyo wete olaukatapeneyano, enileke pademoka wiane mekamuku-ye.
E̱e nimini, wini Masedonia take Yesunomo yakoa motokoi yene peyake wene mekoa mekete tiki. Widikoa moa patukoa kini oya-laweke wedoa wene mekoa meemoa pamene wa totome kiwi kowitoa oko-ye.

Utanele-kama toane poti yawou wa wene pianeya yamene. Ni panagome onekele toa mekale eneketepa dikoa ta dikoa ta wa teiga teiga toameamene. Ni totome mane mane okoona toapa nee eya moadete kini yoname pupu toa mokala tamene.
Yete pade ali atoame kiwi kei pimotono nitamene. Edikoa meketepa nipa ete ali-kitaneya oia moatiki toa mena.
Ali Muno Wakapea Noatekamo

Anu oya-lawe kipala i ukule agopa taneya meamedikili eya wane uku-ye. Yesuke wene tugoa mea tua pekene ali atoake wene keda taneya meameamene. Nipa tuane ali atoa wa kamoa poamoi wa wene pianeya meki-kiti tumai mekete tiki toa toameamene. Ni edoa-mo.

Yesu tuake wa kamoa pekenemo einapa nimini akenemo wa totome wene toko. Tuake kamoa pekeneyano, Yesu-pala lipua mea tukoi peyapa Akolaliyo mana-pala odeneka wakapea nekete noati wa koua noo waka totome wene toko.
Ali Muno agome olaukanemopa totome i okono yakamene. One wakapea noka-pete toto pa meadekolopa nipa oneke wene tugoa mea tukoi yene naniko nomotoa toto namolo takoa Yesu kotua pikilepa toamoo.

Nitamekete eya too. Titikilepa Akolaline bera ta pa piitakutukoa kakaka one ako edelo agome kayo telo ootapeoo. Nitikale Ali Muno agome kotua noe wa kayo oa ketipea noademe nokale Keraisuke wene tugoa mea tukoi ali atoa ate kamoa poi.
Nititikaneyake toto tuameneya pa meko-kitipa one a tibuke kotua pikilepa eni yene-pala wedo pakeke moa obokaneya pekete poo. Nipa enipete titimoa Ali Muno ago-pala pa mea kama kawoo.
Kipala i ukumomepa kini kini wene weye akanali yoma pamene-ye.
